purpose: Independent practice of E2.1 — naming measurable attributes.
student_learning_goal: I can name measurable attributes of objects.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name measurable attributes of objects.
header.character_watermark: Roo the Ruler Rabbit in the top-right corner with a ruler. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each object to its main attribute (length / area / mass / capacity).
parts.visual_layout: Two-column matching: 6 objects on the left (pencil, book, rock, cup, ribbon, blanket), 4 attributes on the right (length, area, mass, capacity). Wide gap for line-drawing.

image_placeholders.description: A two-column matching layout for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 6 object icons stacked (pencil, book, rock, cup, ribbon, blanket), each ~1in. Right column: 4 attribute words stacked (LENGTH, AREA, MASS, CAPACITY) with small icons. Wide gap between columns for line-drawing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_MATCH at Part 1: instructions ask the child to match objects to attributes. Keywords name the categories.

parts.answer_key: Pencil → length. Book → area. Rock → mass. Cup → capacity. Ribbon → length. Blanket → area.

parts.student_instructions: Pick ONE object. Write 2 attributes it has.
parts.visual_layout: Top: a labelled line for the object name. Below: 2 attribute lines.

image_placeholders.description: A labelled object name line and 2 attribute lines for a Grade 1 worksheet. 'My object: ___' on top. Below: 'Attribute 1: ___' and 'Attribute 2: ___' lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_LINES at Part 2: instructions ask the child to name 2 attributes. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any object with 2 valid attributes. E.g., 'desk: length + area'.

parts.student_instructions: Find 3 things at home. Name an attribute for each.

image_placeholders.description: Three response rows for a Grade 1 worksheet. Each row reads 'Object: ___ Attribute: ___' with two writing lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_ROWS at Part 3: instructions ask the child to find home objects. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any 3 home objects with valid attributes.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find an object with 3 attributes.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the diagnostic signal.
